lines: Faculty of Social Science - Geography and Environment

Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from Geography and Environment 1200A/B, Geography and Environment 1300A/B, Geography and Environment 1400F/G, Geography and Environment 1500F/G, Environmental Science 1021F/G, with a mark of at least 60% in each of these courses.

If upper-year students have not completed 1.0 courses listed above, they may select one or two courses from: Geography and Environment 2131A/B, Geography and Environment 2132A/B, Geography and Environment 2152F/G, Geography and Environment 2153A/B, and/or Geography and Environment 2160A/B, in making up the 1.0 admission requirement, as long as they were completed with a grade of at least 60%.
2.0 courses: Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 3350A/B, Geography and Environment 3446F/G, Geography and Environment 4450F/G.

1.0 course from: Biology 2485A/B, Biology 3425F/G, Chemistry 2210A/B, Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 2330A/B, Geography and Environment 3352A/B, Geography and Environment 3354A/B, Geography and Environment 4350A/B, the former Geography and Environment 3353A/B.

0.5 course from: Geography and Environment 2210A/B or any of the statistics courses listed as its anti-requisite, Geography and Environment 2220A/B, Geography and Environment 2230A/B, Geography and Environment 3250A/B.

2.0 courses from: Anthropology 2203F/G or Indigenous Studies 2203F/G, Anthropology 2237A/B, Anthropology 2277A/B, Economics 2172A/B, Economics 3374A/B, Geography and Environment 2144A/B, Geography and Environment 2162A/B, Geography and Environment 2411F/G or Indigenous Studies 2601F/G, Geography and Environment 2430A/B, Geography and Environment 3413F/G, Geography and Environment 3441F/G, Geography and Environment 3443F/G, Geography and Environment 3445F/G, Geography and Environment 4410A/B, Health Sciences 3650F/G, Political Science 3208F/G, Political Science 3379E, Sociology 2155A/B, Sociology 4471F/G, the former Geography and Environment 3414A/B.

1.0 course from: Art History 3674F/G or Museum and Curatorial Studies 3674F/G, Art History 4642F/G, Governance, Leadership and Ethics 2005F/G, History 3721F/G, History 3723F/G, Philosophy 2035F/G, Philosophy 2242F/G, Philosophy 2356F/G, Philosophy 3850F/G, Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies 2165A/B, Gender, Sexuality, and Women’s Studies 3312F/G.
1. 2.5 courses must be from 3000 level or above.
2. Combination with a Major module in Science or Basic Medical Sciences may allow graduation with a 4 year BSc.
3. To qualify for a 4 year BSc degree, 11.0 Science and/or Science-equivalent courses are required.

4. When taken within this module, the following Geography and Environment courses count towards meeting the requirement of 11.0 Science courses in a 4-Year BSc: Geography and Environment 2133A/B, Geography and Environment 2210A/B, Geography and Environment 2310A/B, Geography and Environment 2320A/B, Geography and Environment 3350A/B, Geography and Environment 3352A/B, Geography and Environment 3353A/B, Geography and Environment 3354A/B.
